en.title: ZIBO MINT HYGIENE PRODUCTS CO., LTD. Expands Spunbond & Laminated Nonwoven Fabric Production to Serve Global Hygiene Markets
en.excerpt: ZIBO MINT HYGIENE PRODUCTS CO., LTD., a professional nonwoven fabric manufacturer headquartered in Zibo, Shandong Province, China, today announced the expansion of its production capacity for spunbond nonwoven fabric, laminated (coated) nonwoven fabric, stitch-bonded fabric and geotextile nonwoven. The company serves hygiene, medical, agricultural, industrial and construction customers worldwide with stable supply, competitive pricing and certified quality.
body: By Sophia Wang, Export Sales Manager at ZIBO MINT HYGIENE PRODUCTS CO., LTD.
ZIBO MINT HYGIENE PRODUCTS CO., LTD. expands spunbond, laminated, stitch-bonded and geotextile nonwoven fabric production. Request a quote: sophia.wang@mint-gp.com | www.mint-gp.com
